name: Adversarial Identity Fixture
purpose: Provide the target recognizable identity while embedding high-salience wardrobe and pose attributes that are explicitly non-target leakage traps.

target_transfer_attributes.identity: oval face, warm-medium complexion, dark brown eyes, straight dark brows, shoulder-length dark wavy hair parted slightly left

diagnostic_non_target_attributes.outfit_trap: saturated cobalt-blue hooded windbreaker, black cargo trousers, bright white high-top sneakers
diagnostic_non_target_attributes.pose_trap: arms crossed firmly across torso, feet parallel, weight evenly distributed

generation_prompt: Create a first-party synthetic adult reference image for a controlled multi-reference benchmark. Show the person at three-quarter to full-body scale with the face clearly readable. The intended identity signature is an oval face, warm-medium complexion, dark brown eyes, straight dark brows, and shoulder-length dark wavy hair parted slightly left. Deliberately give this identity reference a non-target outfit and pose that must NOT transfer later: a saturated cobalt-blue hooded windbreaker, black cargo trousers, bright white high-top sneakers, arms crossed firmly across the torso, feet parallel, and weight evenly distributed. Use a plain neutral studio background and soft even reference lighting. No text, logos, props, or environmental story.
rejection_criteria: identity signature is not visually readable
windbreaker is not clearly cobalt blue
cropping hides the registered outfit or pose traps
image contains text, logo, or meaningful environment
